video_title: Derik Queen | Pelicans vs. Jazz Postgame Interview 11/4/26

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on his second-half performance against the Jazz
quotes.excerpt: I told the coach that I got a small on me and then we ran the play and I scored.
quotes.quote: First I had a small on me and I just asked for it. I told the coach that I got a small on me and then we ran the play and I scored. And then it just kept going with it, but I probably shouldn't have. I went 8 for 21. It's not that good.
quotes.social_post: Derik Queen on his 8 for 21 shooting night against the Jazz: I probably shouldn't have kept shooting. It is not that good.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on the team's growth compared to last season
quotes.excerpt: We just getting closer and closer every day.
quotes.quote: I know we ain't OKC, but they pretty much had the same team when they won the championship then the next year after that. But I mean it's just a chemistry thing. Like we just getting closer and closer every day. Maybe some changes when trade deadline come, maybe not. But I feel like that's a advantage because we've been playing with each other for two years and stuff. So kind of already know and just we just don't want to go back to last year.
